newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent/Duabi widens in Asia, flurry of Tapis done.
newsitem.headline: Brent/Duabi widens in Asia, flurry of Tapis done.

text.p: The November Brent/Dubai widened in Singapore on Thursday in the wake of the Brent futures rally overnight, traders and brokers said.
They said November Brent/Dubai was bid at $2.10 per barrel with a notional offer put at $2.20. December was bid at $1.85 with a notional bid at $1.97.
The key November Brent/Dubai was 25 to 30 cents wider than day-earlier Asian quotes and 10 cents wider than London.
Dubai intermonth spreads were steady at 39/45 cents for both November/December and December/January.
The front-month Brent futures contract in London rallied 69 cents to $23.58 per barrel in the wake of an Iraqi missile attack against U.S. jet fighters patrolling the northern no-fly zone.
Brokers said there had been no deals done during Asian hours on Thursday in either Brent/Dubai or Dubai intermonth spreads.
However, they said a flurry of paper Tapis was traded for October, mostly at $22.50 per barrel.
October was quoted at $22.45 to $22.60, up 25 cents from Asia on Wednesday.
Traders and brokers said a European major was involved in at least four October paper Tapis deals, selling at $22.50.
A U.S. refiner sold 100,000 barrels on paper to a trader at $22.50 and 50,000 barrels at $22.55.
A November paper Tapis deal was done at $22.25 between traders.
